steps.heading: Cracking analogies
steps.html:
An analogy shows a relationship. Work out how the first pair connect, then use the SAME link.

Puppy is to dog as kitten is to ___
A puppy is a baby dog → a kitten is a baby cat. ✅

steps.heading: Odd one out
steps.html:
Find the group the words belong to — the odd one is the one that doesn't fit.

rose, tulip, daisy, oak → three flowers and one tree.

steps.stem: Foot is to leg as hand is to ___?
steps.explain: A foot ends a leg; a hand ends an arm.

steps.stem: Which is the ODD ONE OUT?
steps.explain: The others are flowers; oak is a tree.

steps.stem: Which word means 'happening once a year'?
